speaker: Ms K Thanaletchimi
text: asked the Minister for Education (a) how many schools are currently equipped with elderly-friendly facilities like lifts or escalators to cater to the ageing teaching workforce and those who have mobility issues; and (b) for those schools without these facilities, whether there are any plans to install such facilities.

speaker: Ms K Thanaletchimi (Nominated Member)
text: I just wish to know, when lifts are built, are the teachers consulted on the locations where the lifts are to be built?

speaker: Ms K Thanaletchimi
text: A gym is supposed to be where students exercise and they are supposed to be climbing the stairways.

speaker: Ms K Thanaletchimi
text: But instead the lifts are built alongside and not at the mainstream classrooms' column.

speaker: Ms K Thanaletchimi
text: So, I just wonder whether a lot of consultation have gone in before even planning the lifts' location.
